finding: Silent drop after worker SIGKILL at the payment-settlement boundary (pre-repair reproduction, 2026-11-02)
sequence: Worker SIGKILLed inside finalizeVerifiedOrder's stock-lock wait; inbox left processingState=processing, attempt state=succeeded, orders=0.
recoverStaleCommerceJobs(payload, 0) reset the inbox to received and queued a NEW commerce-process-payment-event job.

The new job never executed: the killed worker's payload-jobs row remains processing=true with concurrencyKey commerce.payment-events, and Payload's runJobs excludes every job whose concurrencyKey is currently processing (node_modules/payload/dist/queues/operations/runJobs/index.js).
After 180s of worker cycles the inbox was still 'received', attempts=1, orders=0. Without repair the paid order is never created.

payload_jobs_rows_at_stall.note: recovery-requeued job, permanently blocked by the orphan's concurrency lane

repair: recoverStaleCommerceJobs already resets stale processing payload-jobs rows for commerce-reconcile-subscriptions and commerce-reconcile-referrals; 17E extends the same reset to commerce-process-payment-event so the orphaned job itself becomes runnable again (its handler is idempotent: a processed inbox returns early).
